items.topic: Genshin Impact on Tensor G6 PowerVR GPU
items.launch_claim: Genshin Impact broken/unplayable on Pixel 11 (PowerVR GPU); Google says a game fix is coming.
items.summary: The launch rendering bug (purple textures, unplayable) was fixed by a game-side patch per Android Authority (10 Sep). No Google GPU driver update for it was found. A new problem then showed up: heavy microstutter/jank in Genshin after the September patches, traced to ANGLE (default on). Workaround: Developer options > ANGLE Preferences > set Genshin to Native. Not fixed by Google as of 21 Sep. Genshin also still can't hold 60fps and the phone passes 40 C after 5 minutes.
items.video_wording: Launch-week Genshin glitches were patched by the game in September, but performance is still weak and some owners see stutter.

sources.quote: Launch-time report: unplayable graphics state on Pixel 11.
Pixel 11 owners can't play Genshin Impact, but a fix is on the way (Google to Wired: fix expected in an upcoming Genshin update).
I didn't spot any major graphical glitches in any of the games I played. A recent patch fixed the Genshin Impact issue

sources.quote: Genshin Impact is the exception, where the phone crept up to over 40°C after five minutes

items.gpu_driver_update: None found. The September 2026 Pixel Update Bulletin lists a PowerVR-GPU security fix (CVE-2026-58731), but that is a security patch, not a game fix.

items.topic: AI features by region (India, UK) and language
items.launch_claim: Gemini Intelligence / Proactive Assistance / Magic Cue-style features are US-only.
items.summary: It isn't simply US-only. Here is the split by region. INDIA: Proactive Assistance (the Pixel 11 successor to Magic Cue: suggestions in chat apps and the Phone app, weather insights, At a Glance location suggestions) works on all Pixel 11 models in English only. Magic Cue is NOT listed for Pixel 11 in India; it is listed for Pixel 10 in India. Rambler voice typing (Gboard) supports Hindi 'and other supported Indian languages' and lets you switch languages mid-sentence. Gemini screen automation (multistep tasks inside apps) is US and Korea only, in English and Korean, and its help page lists Pixel 10 and Galaxy S26/Z8 but not Pixel 11. UK: Magic Cue IS available for Pixel 11 in the UK. Proactive Assistance is not offered in the UK or Ireland. All AI features need age 18+ and a personal Google account. Store footnotes say 'Available in select countries and languages'.
items.video_wording: In India you get Proactive Assistance in English and Rambler with Hindi; app-automation tasks remain US-only.

items.topic: Sept/Oct 2026 updates: bugs, battery, standby drain, charging, thermals
items.launch_claim: Bugs and standby drain at launch; updates promised.
items.summary: Pixel 11 got two hotfix OTAs: CD1A.260905.001.A1 (1 Sep) and .B1 (9-10 Sep), both at the 1 Sep 2026 patch level. Google's changelog only says 'fixes critical bugs and improves the performance and stability'. The September Pixel Drop / Android 17 QPR1 (15 Sep) added a fix for 'game lag, choppy framerates, and increased device temperatures' and a mobile-network fix. Sources CONFLICT on whether Pixel 11 got QPR1: 9to5Google and Android Authority's supported-phone list include Pixel 11, while Android Authority's changelog piece and Notebookcheck (16 Sep) say build CP3A.260905.009 went to Pixel 6-10 only. No official battery, standby or charging fix was found. The Wi-Fi standby drain (2.5-3%/h idle on some routers, such as Tenda, TP-Link Omada and Fritz!Box) is still unconfirmed by Google as of 21 Sep. Workaround: set the router to Wi-Fi 5, which brings it to about 1%/h. There is no October 2026 Pixel bulletin yet: the bulletin index lists September 2026 (published 15 Sep, page updated 30 Sep) as the latest. Android 17 QPR3 Beta 1 came out on 2 Oct.
items.video_wording: September hotfixes landed, but there's no confirmed fix yet for standby drain; check for the October update.

items.launch_claim: India prices Rs 89,999 / 1,19,999 / 1,34,999 / 1,86,999; 6 months free Google AI Pro.
items.summary: List prices are unchanged on Google Store India. Flipkart (checked 5 Oct) sells below MRP. The AI Pro claim needs a correction: in India the 6 months of Google AI Pro (Rs 11,700 value) plus 3 months of YouTube Premium come only with the Pixel 11 Pro, Pro XL and Pro Fold, redeemable by 1 Nov 2027. The base Pixel 11 gets only 3 months of YouTube Premium (new users). Google Store India offers: HDFC/ICICI credit card instant cashback (up to Rs 7,000 on Pixel 11 and up to Rs 10,000 on Pro/XL/Fold, EMI purchases only, with a minimum spend), a Rs 9,000 exchange bonus via Cashify and no-cost EMI up to 12 months. India configurations: no 1TB model. Pixel 11 comes in 256/512GB with 12GB RAM. Pro/XL come in 256GB/12GB or 512GB/16GB. The Fold is sold only as 512GB/16GB in Olive. Pre-orders opened 12 Aug and sales started 20 Aug. Flipkart Big Billion Days effective prices are from secondary sources (not checked on Flipkart).

findings.weight_handling: Pixel 11 weighs 197 g and is comfortable but has a slippery frame (GSMArena). Pro: 204 g, 'surprisingly hefty' for 6.3-inch, slippery. Pro XL: 226 g. Fold: 239 g (Google Store India).
findings.buttons: The power button sits above the volume rocker, an unusual layout (GSMArena, Pixel 11 and 11 Pro).
findings.camera_bump: Pixel 11: 'no wobble when you place the phone on a flat surface' (GSMArena). Pro: all camera hardware is now under one piece of glass (GSMArena).
findings.speakers: Stereo (the earpiece acts as the second speaker). HotHardware: 'pleasantly loud and clear'. GSMArena: 'the stereo speakers sound good'. No loudness measurement was found.
findings.haptics: HotHardware: 'Strong and precise thanks to a quality linear vibration motor.'
findings.fingerprint: Ultrasonic under-display reader. GSMArena: 'snappy and accurate' (11) and 'worked quickly and reliably' (11 Pro).
findings.face_unlock: Android Authority (26 Sep): secure enough to unlock sensitive apps and authenticate payments. It did not name the class.
findings.modem_reception: MediaTek M90 5G modem replaces Samsung Exynos 5400 (HotHardware). Android Authority tests: holds 5G where Pixel 10 Pro dropped to 4G, with faster downloads. Uploads trail the Galaxy S26 Ultra (61.6 vs 100.5 Mbps), but it 'no longer feels like the phone's obvious weak point'. Some owners report 5G showing with no data (AA problems page). All tests were on US/Canada networks; no India network test was found.
findings.repairability: JerryRigEverything teardown (via Android Police, 24 Aug): 'just as easy to repair as the previous Pixel models'. iFixit has Pixel 11 Pro / Pro Fold device pages; no iFixit score was found.
findings.india_repair_warranty: 1-year warranty (Google Store India spec pages; Flipkart '1 year domestic warranty'). India has 20+ Pixel walk-in centres, including 4 Google Exclusive ones (Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Bangalore) open 7 days a week. Google says 9 in 10 phones are repaired in under 4 hours if handed in before 2 PM. Paid pickup/drop is available in Bangalore. Pixel Repair Mode keeps your data. No India Pixel Care+ was found.
findings.esim_india: Dual SIM (one nano SIM + eSIM) on all four models (Google Store India). Jio, Airtel and Vi offer eSIM in general, but no carrier page listing Pixel 11 was found (Airtel's Pixel eSIM page only lists models up to Pixel 7).
findings.in_box: Phone, 1 m USB-C to USB-C cable (USB 2.0) and SIM tool. No charger (Google Store India; HotHardware: 'no ... charger in the box'). HotHardware also says there is no reverse wireless charging.
findings.india_network: The India Pixel 11 page lists model GUJ0N with 5G Sub-6 bands 1/3/5/7/8/28/40/41/77/78 among others, and NavIC GNSS.

items.topic: Official India specs: brightness, zoom, refresh rate
items.summary: Confirmed on store.google.com/in spec pages. Base Pixel 11: 6.3-inch 1080x2424 OLED, 60-120 Hz (not LTPO), up to 2,000 nits HDR and 3,000 nits peak, 'Super Zoom up to 30x', 5x optical telephoto (10.8 MP). Pixel 11 Pro and Pro XL: LTPO, 1-120 Hz, up to 2,400 nits HDR and 3,600 nits peak, 'Pro Zoom up to 120x', 48 MP 5x telephoto. Pro Fold: 1-120 Hz, 2,000 HDR and 3,600 peak, 'Super Zoom up to 30x'. Video zoom is 20x on all models.

what_changed_since_launch: Genshin rendering bug was fixed by a game patch (by 10 Sep), but ANGLE-related stutter has appeared since (21 Sep).
HiLight messages-from-favourites is in QPR2 beta only; stable is unchanged.
Two Pixel 11 hotfix OTAs in September. Whether Pixel 11 got QPR1 is disputed between sources. No confirmed standby-drain or charging fix.
India AI Pro offer is Pro/XL/Fold only (6 months, redeem by 1 Nov 2027). Base Pixel 11 gets YouTube Premium for 3 months only.
Flipkart now sells about Rs 10,000-12,000 below MRP; Big Billion Days effective prices start at Rs 69,999.
